description: VoteMichna.com is the official campaign website of Michael “Mike” Michna, Republican candidate for TX House District 134 in Harris County. The site outlines his background as a U.S. Marine Corps veteran and Houston firefighter, his conservative priorities, and ways for voters to get involved in the 2026 election.
